description: Cross-language corpus for the SDK workspace overlay reading of SKILL.md metadata.version (§4.3.4, §6.4). Generated by test/vectors/skill_metadata_version_test.go; regenerate with UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 go test ./test/vectors/. go_version is the version manifest.ResolveSkillVersion resolves from skill_md and artifact_md, with no ARTIFACT.md when a case has no artifact_md, "" when Go resolves no usable version and null when Go does not parse skill_md. sdk_version is the version each SDK overlay must report: the declared reading of a case in the readable form the TypeScript and Python overlays implement, and the assigned 0.0.0-auto.0 for every other case. A case with no artifact_md runs twice, once as a SKILL.md-only package and once beside default_artifact_md, an ARTIFACT.md of type skill that declares no version, and both runs report sdk_version. A case with artifact_md runs once, beside it.

cases.skill_md:
---
name: greet
description: Greet the user politely.
metadata:
  version: &v 1.0.0
---
Greet the user by name.
